acquisition method: A data-dependent top 5 method was operated
cleavage agent: enzymatic hydrolyses were performed by the addition of 0.2 µg of tosyl phenylalanyl chloromethyl ketone (TPCK)-treated trypsin
enrichment method: Protein complexes were purified by immunoprecipitation and subsequent protein-A affinity pulldown
fragmentation method: higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) spectra were obtained
instrument: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed on a Q-Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer
ionization type: equipped with an EASY-Spray nano-electrospray ion source
reduction reagent: Proteins were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (final concentration)
reduction concentration: Proteins were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (final concentration)
